spec.description: Six-quarter trend by lab and domain: a grid of small sparklines, one row per lab and one column per core domain, each cell tinted by this quarter's band with the current score and band word.

params.name: title
params.value: SIX-QUARTER TREND BY LAB AND DOMAIN

title.subtitle: Cells shaded by this quarter's band: Healthy 80 and above · Watch 60 to 79 · Act below 60

transform.calculate: datum.x0 + 10 + (datum.x1 - datum.x0 - 22) * (datum.quarter - datum.firstQuarter) / max(1, datum.lastQuarter - datum.firstQuarter)
datum.sparkBase - (datum.sparkBase - datum.sparkTop) * (clamp(datum.score, datum.sparkLow, datum.sparkHigh) - datum.sparkLow) / (datum.sparkHigh - datum.sparkLow)
datum.band === 'healthy' ? emerald : datum.band === 'watch' ? amber : datum.band === 'act' ? red : muted
datum.band === 'healthy' ? goodFill : datum.band === 'watch' ? warnFill : datum.band === 'act' ? badFill : sage
